name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber HTPETG
filament_notes:
High Strength (black, more carbon fiber) and High Impact (Galaxy Black, less carbon fiber) HTPETG, with ABS/ASA-level heat resistance.
Product pages: nozzle up to 300C (hotter improves layer adhesion but risks overheating when printing slowly), bed 100C+, flow below 100% and a nozzle wipe at layer change to limit buildup. Proto-Pasta's launch article (EX14) printed at 300C and chose 6 mm3/s for a full melt. This profile's 260C with a 12 mm3/s cap is our own middle-ground choice, not a Proto-Pasta number.
Dry before printing (wet filament causes nozzle buildup). Hard steel nozzle required (abrasive). EX14 also turned auxiliary and chamber fans off and used glue stick.
